test_resize_transform: test the Resize pipeline transform for image scaling with keep_ratio and multiscale_mode options
test_flip_transform: test the RandomFlip pipeline transform for horizontal vertical and diagonal image flipping
test_random_crop_transform: test the RandomCrop pipeline transform with absolute relative and relative_range crop types

test_cutout_transform: test the CutOut pipeline transform for random cutout augmentation with configurable holes and fill values
